mechanism: Vitamin D is essential for calcium absorption and regulation; zoledronic acid (bisphosphonate) increases bone mineral density but can cause hypocalcemia, making adequate vitamin D status critical for therapeutic efficacy and safety.
action: Ensure adequate vitamin D levels (target 25-OH vitamin D ≥30 ng/mL) before and during zoledronic acid therapy; supplementation is recommended to prevent hypocalcemia and optimize bisphosphonate efficacy.
